Article begins on PDF page 23; explicit problem blocks occur on PDF pages 26-75.
Extracted 89 explicit Hungarian probléma blocks; OCR marker lines are preserved as needs_review evidence.
No accepted rewrites produced because the OCR-visible statements rely on unresolved formulas, source-specific notation, and Hungarian OCR text.
